whatAYeaDid: Gave third reading and enacted the Official Plan and Zoning By-law amendments (Bill No.'s 531 and 548) for 560 and 562 Wellington Street (OZ-8462), the housing rezoning application decided under Item 17 (3.7) of the same meeting.

whatAYeaDid: Received and forwarded the communication on the City's 2021-22 Winter Response Program for Unsheltered Individuals to Item 8 (2.5) of the 15th Report of the Community and Protective Services Committee for consideration.
quote: That the following communications BE RECEIVED and BE FORWARDED as noted on the Agenda: 6.1     The City of London 2021-22 Winter Response Program for Unsheltered Individuals (SS21-40, SS21-41, SS21-42, SS21-43) - refer to Item 8 (2.5) of the 15th Report of the Community and Protective Services Committee

whatAYeaDid: Amended Item 9 (3.1) to add a new part directing the Civic Administration to prepare an alternate draft by-law specifically regulating the distribution of flyers containing graphic images of dismembered human beings or aborted fetuses, including enforcement and penalty provisions.
quote: That Item 9 (3.1) BE AMENDED to add the following new part b): b)     the Civic Administration BE DIRECTED to prepare an alternate draft by-law for consideration of Municipal Council, specific to the distribution of graphic flyers, that would incorporate the following measures; i)     to specifically regulate flyers containing graphic images of dismembered human beings or aborted fetuses to residences; ii)    to identified sources of municipal authority supporting the above-noted measure, [10(2) powers]; and, iii)   to include provisions providing for enforcement and penalties for violations of the by-law;

whatAYeaDid: Would have further amended Item 9 (3.1) to direct staff to use City communication channels to promote the Trespass to Property Act as a means for residents to avoid unwanted flyer deliveries from specific organizations.
quote: That Item 9 (3.1) BE FURTHER AMENDED, to include the following: That staff BE DIRECTED to use city channels of communication to promote the Trespass to Property Act as a means for residents to avoid the delivery of unwanted flyers from specific organizations.

whatAYeaDid: Approved Item 9 (3.1), as amended, referring the draft flyer-delivery by-law back to the Civic Administration for revisions to include enforcement measures, and directing preparation of a separate draft by-law specifically regulating graphic flyers.
quote: That Item 9 (3.1), as amended, BE APPROVED.

whatAYeaDid: Approved part b) of Item 9 (3.1), as amended, directing the Civic Administration to prepare an alternate draft by-law specifically regulating the distribution of flyers containing graphic images of dismembered human beings or aborted fetuses, citing evidence that such flyers cause demonstrable harm to residents.
quote: That part b) of Item 9 (3.1), as amended, BE APPROVED: b)     that Civic Administration be directed to prepare an alternate draft bylaw for committee and council consideration specific to the distribution of graphic flyers; i) to specifically regulate flyers containing graphic images of dismembered human beings or aborted fetuses to residences for consideration by council, ii) to include in the by-law identified sources of municipal authority supporting this measure, [10(2) powers] and acknowledge the substantial evidence received by council from Londoners that such unsolicited Flyers cause demonstrable harm to London residents. iii) and that the by-law include provisions providing for enforcement and penalties for violation of its terms.

whatAYeaDid: Directed the Civic Administration to submit an application to demolish the heritage-designated property at 100 Stanley Street as part of the Wharncliffe Road South improvements process, subject to further consultation with the London Advisory Committee on Heritage and a public participation meeting.
quote: That, on the recommendation of the Deputy City Manager, Environment and Infrastructure, with consideration of the March 23, 2021 Council resolution, the Civic Administration BE DIRECTED to submit an application to Council to demolish the heritage designated property at 100 Stanley Street, it being noted that the application process requires further consultation with the London Advisory Committee on Heritage and a public participation meeting at the Planning and Environment Committee to consider the application.

whatAYeaDid: Referred the question of whether Blackfriars Bridge remains closed to vehicles indefinitely to a future Civic Works Committee meeting, pending a required usage study under the Provincial Environmental Assessment and further public engagement.
quote: That consideration of the Blackfriars Bridge remaining closed to vehicles indefinitely BE REFERRED to a future meeting of the Civic Works Committee in order for the Civic Administration to complete the required usage study as required in the Provincial EA, provide the related report to council, and allow for a more fulsome public engagement with respect to this matter.

whatAYeaDid: Amended the Draft Guiding Principles for the Mobility Master Plan Development to add "Efficiency" as an additional principle.
quote: That part a) BE AMENDED by adding the following additional Draft Guiding Principle:  "Efficiency".

whatAYeaDid: Amended part a) of Item 17 (3.7) to introduce a revised by-law redesignating 560 and 562 Wellington Street from Low Density Residential to Multi-Family High Density Residential, permitting a height increase to 17 storeys and a density increase to 807 units per hectare, with affordable housing provided through a bonus zone.
quote: That, based on the application of 560 Wellington Holdings Inc., relating to the property located at 560 and 562 Wellington Street: a)     the proposed attached revised by-law BE INTRODUCED at the Municipal Council meeting to be held on November 16, 2021 to amend the Official Plan (1989) to change the designation FROM a Low Density Residential designation TO a Multi-Family, High Density Residential Designation, and to ADD a Specific Area Policy in Chapter 10 – Policies for Specific Areas to permit an increased height of 17 storeys (61 m); an increase density of 807 units per hectare; a limited range of commercial uses in the Multi-Family, High Density Residential designation and the provision of affordable housing units implemented through a Bonus Zone;

whatAYeaDid: Amended part b) of Item 17 (3.7) to specify bonus-zone implementation terms for 560 and 562 Wellington Street, committing to twelve affordable residential rental units with rents capped at 70% of average market rent for 25 years from initial occupancy.
quote: That part b) of Item 17 (3.7) BE AMENDED by adding the following to the end of part b): "it being noted that the Bonus Zone shall be implemented through one or more agreements to facilitate a high quality development comprised of a mixed-use apartment building with a maximum height of 17 storeys (61 m), and a maximum density of 807 units per hectare, which generally implements the Site Plan and Elevations attached as Schedule “1” to the amending by-law and provides for affordable housing as follows: - A total of twelve affordable residential rental units; with seven units to be provided within the development at 560 and 562 Wellington Street, and five units to be provided in existing inventory upon the completion of site plan approval; - Rents not exceeding 70% of the Average Market Rent (AMR) for the London Census Metropolitan Area as determined by the CMHC at the time of building occupancy; - The duration of affordability shall be set at 25 years from the point of initial occupancy of all affordable units; it being noted that Civic Administration is encouraged to speak with Auburn Developments on the tenant selection process for the affordable units"

whatAYeaDid: Amended Item 17 (3.7) to add that no further notice be given under Section 34(17) of the Planning Act, as the recommended zoning implements the site concept submitted with the application.
quote: That Item 17 (3.7) BE AMENDED by adding the following new part c): "c)     pursuant to Section 34(17) of the Planning Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. P.13, as determined by the Municipal Council, no further notice BE GIVEN in respect of the proposed by-law as the recommended zoning implements the site concept submitted with the application;"

whatAYeaDid: Amended Item 17 (3.7) to add Council's stated reasoning for approving the application notwithstanding staff's advice, citing consistency with the Provincial Policy Statement's promotion of intensification and redevelopment while conserving significant heritage resources.
quote: That Item 17 (3.7) BE AMENDED by adding the following at the end of the clause: "it being further noted that notwithstanding the advice of staff, municipal council is of the belief that this application is approved for the following reasons: -    the proposed development is consistent with the Provincial Policy Statement, 2020, which promotes intensification and redevelopment in appropriate locations, while conserving significant heritage resources;"

whatAYeaDid: Approved Item 17 (3.7), as amended, introducing by-laws to redesignate and rezone 560 and 562 Wellington Street from Low Density Residential to Multi-Family High Density Residential, permitting a 17-storey, 807-units-per-hectare mixed-use apartment building with twelve affordable rental units secured through a bonus zone.
quote: a)     the proposed  revised by-law BE INTRODUCED at the Municipal Council meeting to be held on November 16, 2021 to amend the Official Plan (1989) to change the designation FROM a Low Density Residential designation TO a Multi-Family, High Density Residential Designation, and to ADD a Specific Area Policy in Chapter 10 – Policies for Specific Areas to permit an increased height of 17 storeys (61 m); an increase density of 807 units per hectare; a limited range of commercial uses in the Multi-Family, High Density Residential designation and the provision of affordable housing units implemented through a Bonus Zone;

whatAYeaDid: Would have referred the Red Maple Properties development application for 1453-1459 Oxford Street East and 648-656 Ayerswood Avenue back to the Civic Administration to work with the applicant on a framework for affordable housing units at 70% of average market rent for fifty years, resolving sanitary sewer capacity issues, and revising the application to consolidate the properties within the Rapid Transit Corridor.
quote: That the application by Red Maple Properties, relating to the properties located at 1453 to 1459 Oxford Street East and 648 to 656 Ayerswood Avenue BE REFERRED to the Civic Administration to undertake the following actions and to report back to a future meeting of the Planning and Environment Committee to: a)  work with the applicant to ensure the appropriate framework is in place for the provision of affordable housing units at 70% of the average market rate for fifty years; b) work with the applicant to determine options to resolve the sanitary sewer capacity issues; and, c)  work with the applicant to revise the application to consolidate the subject properties as being within the Rapid Transit Corridor;
